description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_DateTime, which represents XML-RPC dateTime values in the Zend Framework. It extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar and provides functionality for handling ISO8601 date formats for XML-RPC communication.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_DateTime
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC datetime value within the Zend Framework, supporting conversion from various date/time representations to ISO8601 string format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a date/time value, capable of accepting Unix timestamps, DateTime objects, Zend_Date objects, or parsable date strings, converting them into the ISO8601 format used in XML-RPC.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the stored date/time value as a string in ISO8601 format.
